visual_concept: 一个人坐在办公桌前，右手揉成写有“prompt”的纸团扔向垃圾桶，眼睛看向电脑屏幕上显示的CRM、评分系统等工程架构图，肩上青椒指着屏幕。桌上散落几个纸团和键盘。
image_prompt:
A FLAT EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION in classic editorial magazine cover art style. Ink and watercolor on textured paper, designed-not-rendered, with visible hand-drawn linework and intentional limited color palette. This is NOT a photograph, NOT a 3D render, NOT a cinematic concept-art image. Think the look of a printed editorial illustration on paper.

SUBJECT:
A person (cartoon, neutral gender, late 20s to early 30s, wearing a deep sea-blue knit sweater, thin-rimmed glasses) sits at a desk. The person is holding a crumpled piece of paper with the word "prompt" written on it, right hand in the motion of tossing it toward a wastebasket on the floor. The left arm rests on the desk. The person's gaze is directed toward a computer monitor on the desk. On the monitor screen, a simplified system architecture diagram is shown: nodes labeled "CRM", "评分系统", "fallback案例" connected by lines. On the desk, there are a few more crumpled paper balls and a keyboard. On the person's shoulder sits a cartoon green pepper (anthropomorphic, with eyes and a small expression), pointing one of its tiny arms at the computer screen.

CHARACTER (the host):
A cartoon-style person, neutral gender, late 20s to early 30s, 3D toy-figurine quality (like designer vinyl figures, NOT realistic 3D). Wearing a deep sea-blue knit sweater or hoodie. Thin-rimmed glasses. On the character's shoulder: a cartoon green pepper (anthropomorphic, with expressive eyes, small but clearly visible). The pepper has a focused expression. The person and the pepper are INTERACTING with the subject scene — pointing at the screen, crumpling paper. NOT just posing in front of it.

STYLE (critical — must enforce):
- FLAT ILLUSTRATION, ink and watercolor style
- visible brush strokes, paper texture, hand-drawn linework
- matte finish, designed-not-rendered
- limited color palette with intentional whitespace
- NO photorealism, NO CGI, NO cinematic rendering
- NO glossy plastic, NO chrome, NO 3D realism
- NO photographic depth-of-field, NO bokeh

LIGHTING & MOOD:
- Warm natural light from left, but expressed through flat washes
- NOT cinematic lighting, NOT realistic shadows

COMPOSITION (the one principle: CANVAS UNITY):
- 2.35:1 horizontal aspect ratio = 47:20 (1920×816 default; 2400×1024 if high-res)
**THE WHOLE CANVAS IS ONE DESIGNED OBJECT.** Every region of the canvas has intentional purpose — either intentional content, or intentional negative space that serves the design (not accidentally empty). There must be NO disconnected islands: no floating title, no isolated character, no forgotten corner.
The viewer should read the canvas as a single unified composition, not as multiple stacked elements or compartments.
How to achieve: the title text is integrated as a large banner attached to the upper part of the desk or as a thought bubble connected to the person's head, visually bridging the person and the screen. The crumpled papers create a flow from hand to wastebasket, linking the left, center, and lower areas. The monitor and desk form a solid base. No part feels cut off.
- Diagnostic checks: no accidentally empty zones; title is not floating; all elements are interconnected; each third of the canvas has meaning.

COLOR PALETTE (strict, with area proportions):
Design philosophy: "gentle yet sharp" (温和的锋利) — warm paper as the dominant reading surface, blue used as a signature accent for brand identity, NOT as volume.
- DOMINANT BACKGROUND (≥50% of image area): warm cream (#FAF3DD) or off-white (#FDF6E3) — the paper-reading surface.
- BRAND SIGNATURE COLOR (15-25%): deep sea blue (#1B4965) — used for the person's sweater, the main title text, and the outline of the computer monitor.
- secondary (10-15%): indigo (#3D5A80) — for shadows under the desk, the wastebasket, secondary text labels on the screen.
- emphasis (5-10%): royal blue (#293B8A) — for the number "80%" in the title and the word "工程" (engineering).
- single accent (≤5%): terracotta (#E07A5F) — for the green pepper's hat or a small highlight on the wastebasket.
- NO pure black, NO pure white, NO rainbow gradients, NO neon.
- Overall image must read as "warm paper with disciplined blue details".

TEXT IN IMAGE:
- main title: "80%时间干工程" — Chinese, in 思源宋体 or 霞鹜文楷 style serif, large and dominant, occupying ≥40% of visual weight. Positioned top center as a banner or integrated into the desk surface as a plaque.
- No subtitle or corner text.

NEGATIVE:
- NO abstract neural network diagrams
- NO glowing brain or digital head
- NO robot-human handshake
- NO circuit board background
- NO data stream / particle flows
- NO gradient geometric shapes
- NO VR goggles, NO AR headsets
- NO holographic UI floating in air
- NO futuristic city skyline
- NO chrome/metallic AI face
- NO binary code rain
- NO glossy plastic finish
- NO real-world brand logos or trademarks (commercial use risk)
- NO photographic realism, NO cinematic concept art

NEGATIVE (character-specific, additional):
- NO fisherman hat (花叔's signature)
- NO animal ears, NO tail, NO mascot fur
- NO plaid shirt, NO branded hoodies
- NO VR/AR gear, NO mechanical arms or armor
